page.overview:
Who is Huazo?

Huazo and Chaeryu fell in love as teenagers, which was not considered proper for a Fire Lord and his future partner. To retreat from the stresses of court, the couple usually retreated to the wilderness. Chaeryu would pack as little as possible on their journeys, wishing to be close to nature, and he and Huazo would often bicker.

At some point, Chaeryu came to believe that he could do better than Huazo. The Saowon clan was weak at the time, and Huazo was not well-received in the capital as mistress of the Fire Lord. Chaeryu's ministers, many of whom were from the Sei'naka clan, instead promoted Lady Sulan of the Keohso clan, introducing her to Chaeryu at a garden party. As soon as he laid eyes on the woman, any lingering thoughts of Huazo vanished.

Despite being replaced by her in Chaeryu's eyes, Huazo never hated Sulan. By this point, she was pregnant with Chaeryu's first child, a fact she would later take great pleasure in revealing to the Fire Lord due to the embarrassment it caused him. She gave birth to a son named Chaejin, who was acknowledged by Chaeryu to avoid dishonoring Huazo and the Saowon clan. Sulan became pregnant with a son of Chaeryu's herself some time later, and arranged with him to have the child named Zoryu, unaware that this would be considered a heinous insult since the name's first character had traditionally been used only by the Saowon clan. After Sulan died in childbirth and Huazo learned of the name, she was less offended than she was incredulous that the late Fire Lady could be so foolish and naïve, convincing Chaejin to anger her family's rival clan just so she could give her son a name that sounded pretty.

Chaejin and Zoryu were initially playmates, but Chaeryu later sent Huazo's son away to the Fire Sages and excluded him from the line of succession, forbidding anyone to talk about the matter for the remainder of his reign.
